entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You know how you can use your card[n]to get into banks during after hours?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I thought that I'd be able to get in since[n]I have the same identity as such[n]customers.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm Kaneshiro's source of revenue,[n]after all.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But wow... This place is huge.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I rarely gotta go to the bank, so...[n]this's makin' me kinda nervous.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Being in a bank with costumes like these[n]is so obvious—we're totally robbers.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It seems there will be a lot of Shadows[n]from here on.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I've trained in aikido. Don't worry; I can[n]defend myself.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Self-defense won't do much good[n]against Shadows, but then again,[n]it's better than nothing.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We have to go in from the front,[n]don't we? I'm an honorary customer,[n]so I better act like one.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I will be useful for you guys.
